Part of [F_380](F_380_add_possibility_to_support_task_tracking_tool.md). Provider-neutral task list on the conversation, persisted and sent to the renderer. Provider decoders ([F_432](F_432_claude_task_list_decoder.md), [F_433](F_433_codex_plan_decoder.md)) and the panel ([F_434](F_434_agent_task_list_component.md)) build on this.

## Current state

* Provider events become conversation entries in `agent_runner_service.js` (`handleProviderEvent`, `recordProviderEvent`) and reach the renderer as `agentEvent` updates with an `entryIndex` (`desktop/src/actions/action/action_run.js`).
* Conversation-level fields use their own update kind, e.g. `agentUsage` (`action_run.js`, `app/src/data/action_run_types.ts`, `app/src/services/actions/action_run_registry.ts`).
* `parseAgentConversationValue` (`shared/agent_conversations.mjs`) rebuilds the conversation from known fields only, so an unknown field is lost on reload.

## Implementation details

* Shape, stored as `conversation.taskList`:

  ```
  { tasks: [{ id, subject, status: 'pending' | 'inProgress' | 'completed', activeForm? }], updatedAt }
  ```

  Every change replaces the whole list (Codex sends full snapshots; Claude lists are small).
* Desktop runner: a run event `{ type: 'taskList', taskList }` from either decoder sets `run.conversation.taskList`, is included in the persisted checkpoint, and is emitted to the action run.
* `action_run.js`: publish it as update `{ kind: 'agentTaskList', taskList }`, next to `agentUsage`. No new IPC channel.
* `shared/agent_conversations.mjs`: validate and keep `taskList` in `parseAgentConversationValue`. An invalid list fails the parse like other invalid fields. Conversations without the field have no `taskList`.
* Renderer types: add `taskList?` to `AgentConversation` (`app/src/data/data_types.ts`) and the update kind to `action_run_types.ts`.
* `action_run_registry.ts`: apply `agentTaskList` to `conversation.taskList` with its own `conversationChange` kind, so transcript subscribers do not treat it as an entry change.

## Tests

* `parseAgentConversationValue`: valid list kept, invalid list rejected, absent list stays absent.
* Runner/action run: a `taskList` run event updates the conversation and publishes `agentTaskList`.
* Registry: `agentTaskList` replaces `conversation.taskList` and leaves entries untouched.

Part of [F_380](F_380_add_possibility_to_support_task_tracking_tool.md). Turn Codex plan updates into the task list from [F_431](F_431_agent_task_list_model_and_run_update.md).

## Current state

* Streaming (`app-server`): Codex sends `turn/plan/updated` with `{ threadId, turnId, explanation?, plan: [{ step, status: 'pending' | 'inProgress' | 'completed' }] }` (verified against the codex 0.156 app-server schema). `handleNotification` in `agent_streaming_adapter.js` has no branch for it, so it is dropped.
* One-shot (`exec --json`): the plan arrives as a `todo_list` item. It is not in `SUPPORTED_CODEX_ITEM_TYPES` (`agent_codex_event.js`), so `AgentProviderProtocolParser` records a "Codex protocol diagnostic" row on `item.completed`. `item.updated` events are not handled. The item shape is assumed to be `{ id, type: 'todo_list', items: [{ text, completed }] }`; verify against codex 0.156 before implementing.
* The existing Codex `plan` item and `item/plan/delta` belong to plan-mode proposals and stay unchanged.

## Implementation details

* Streaming: handle `turn/plan/updated` for the root thread and emit a `taskList` run event. Task id = step index, subject = `step`, status as sent. Child-thread plans are merged into the same list with ids prefixed by thread id. `explanation` is not shown.
* One-shot: on `item.started`, `item.updated` and `item.completed` of a `todo_list` item, emit a `taskList` run event (status `completed` or `pending`; exec has no in-progress state). No diagnostic row and no transcript entry for it.
* Each update replaces the list; a new turn's plan replaces the previous one.
* When the setting from [F_430](F_430_agent_task_tracking_setting.md) is off, Codex is started with `-c tools.update_plan.enabled=false` and sends no plan updates, so this decoder needs no setting check of its own.

## Tests

* Streaming adapter: `turn/plan/updated` produces the expected list; child-thread plan merged.
* Protocol parser: `todo_list` across started/updated/completed produces lists and no diagnostic or transcript entry.

Part of [F_380](F_380_add_possibility_to_support_task_tracking_tool.md). Turn Claude's task tool calls into the task list from [F_431](F_431_agent_task_list_model_and_run_update.md). Needs [F_430](F_430_agent_task_tracking_setting.md) for Claude to have the tools.

## Current state

* Claude task tools arrive as ordinary `tool_use` blocks. Streaming renders them through `claudeToolEvent` (`agent_claude_streaming_adapter.js`) as `tool.TaskCreate` / `tool.TaskUpdate` rows with raw JSON; one-shot records them through `claudeTranscriptEvents` (`agent_claude_events.js`).
* `agent_claude_events.js` holds decoders shared by the one-shot parser (`agent_provider_protocol.js`) and `ClaudeStreamingAdapter`; new decoders must live there. `ClaudeFileResultDecoder` already pairs a `tool_use` with its `tool_result` and reads `tool_use_result` when one result block is present.
* Sub-agent events carry `parent_tool_use_id`.

## Implementation details

* Add `ClaudeTaskListDecoder` (own file) used by both paths:
  * `TaskCreate`: remember `{ subject, activeForm }` by `tool_use.id`. On the matching `tool_result`, read the task id from `tool_use_result.task.id` and add the task as `pending`. Ignore results with `is_error`.
  * `TaskUpdate`: read the id from `taskId`, falling back to `id` / `task_id` (Claude Code repairs these names before execution, the stream shows the raw input). Apply `status` (`in_progress` â†’ `inProgress`), `subject`, `activeForm`. `status: 'deleted'` removes the task. Unknown ids are logged and skipped.
  * Each change emits the full list as a `taskList` run event.
  * `TodoWrite` is not decoded (only appears with `CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_TASKS=0`, which md2 does not set).
* Sub agents: merge their task changes into the same list. Task ids are expected to be unique per Claude session; verify during implementation. If ids collide between parent and sub agent, key sub-agent tasks by `parent_tool_use_id` + task id.
* Hide: task tool calls and their results produce no transcript entries in either path. `TaskGet` and `TaskList` are hidden too; they read state and change nothing.
* Reset decoder state where `ClaudeFileResultDecoder.reset()` is called.

## Edge cases

* After `--resume`, Claude's own task state may differ from the stored list; the stored list shows until the next change replaces it.
* A `TaskUpdate` before its `TaskCreate` result arrives: skipped and logged.

## Tests

Fixture stream-json events, run through both the one-shot parser and `ClaudeStreamingAdapter`:

* create â†’ update â†’ complete â†’ delete produces the expected lists.
* Fallback id keys, `is_error` results, sub-agent tasks merged.
* No transcript entries for task tools.

* `ActionConversationChat` (`app/src/components/actions/conversation/action_conversation_chat.tsx`) lays out the transcript, status area and prompt.

* New self-contained component `AgentTaskList` in `app/src/components/actions/conversation/tasks/agent_task_list.tsx`. It receives only what identifies the displayed conversation and subscribes itself with `useSyncExternalStore`; `getSnapshot` returns `conversation.taskList` (a stable reference that changes only on `agentTaskList`). No task data or handlers come from the parent, so it can be moved elsewhere later.
* Initial placement: in `ActionConversationChat`, directly above the prompt.
* Renders nothing when there is no list or it is empty.
* Each row: status icon (pending / in progress / completed) and text; an in-progress task shows `activeForm` when present, otherwise `subject`. Header shows `completed/total`. Collapsible, expanded by default, compact height with scrolling for long lists.
* Styling per `design/STYLE_GUIDE.md` and the existing conversation status components.
* Works the same for live and historical conversations.

## Tests

React Testing Library:

* Renders tasks with their states and the progress count.
* Shows `activeForm` for the in-progress task.
* Renders nothing without a task list.
* Updates when an `agentTaskList` update arrives.
